prose_chunks.text: As referenced on our third quarter 2025 financial results call, on November 6, 2026,  we have combined our legacy Viator and Brand Tripadvisor experiences operations to support the Company’s priorities, including in experiences, and as a result, are updating our segments with our fourth quarter and full year 2025 reporting, and on a go-forward basis.  To ensure that investors have a basis for comparison, attached are segment financials, which have been recast by quarter in the new segment structure, going back to Q1 2023. We now report our financial results in the following three reportable segments: Experiences, Hotels and Other, and TheFork.  A summary of the changes is noted below:
